source.inventory_method: source-first high-recall scan independent of semantic mapping

normative_units.summary: PED treatment and direct complications are excluded for continuous coverage from first My Health Care Plan; the selected PED duration is stated in the Policy Schedule. Plan 1 shows 36 months and the wording exposes selectable PED waiting-period options of 1, 2, or 3 years.
normative_units.pressure_point: A single product/UIN can carry schedule-selected waiting-period duration. Publication must bind the selected schedule value/applicability cell rather than hard-code one product-wide scalar.

normative_units.summary: Specified disease/procedure treatment is excluded for a Policy-Schedule-selected continuous-coverage period, with accident exception, SI-enhancement restart, longer-of-PED interaction, post-inception applicability, portability credit, and selectable 1/2/3-year schedule options; Plan 1 shows 24 months.
normative_units.pressure_point: Same product/UIN exposes schedule-selected duration cells for a base exclusion.

normative_units.summary: Plan 1 records an Initial Waiting Period of 30 days.
Doctor Prescribed Lab and Radiology Cover has an initial 30-day illness waiting period in the first policy year and the waiting period does not apply on renewals.
normative_units.pressure_point: Benefit-scoped initial wait plus explicit renewal cessation must not be merged into the global initial waiting-period mechanic.

normative_units.summary: Doctor Prescribed Lab and Radiology Cover separately applies the PED waiting-period mechanic using the Policy-Schedule-selected duration, portability credit, and post-wait declaration/acceptance condition.
Maternity Expenses waiting period is 36 months for Plan 1 and decreases by one year when premium for a long-term policy is paid upfront.
normative_units.pressure_point: waiting_periods_v1 currently certifies INITIAL, SPECIFIC_DISEASE_PROCEDURE, and PRE_EXISTING_DISEASE base mechanics; maternity is a distinct waiting-period type and the reduction is conditional on premium-term/payment state rather than an optional waiting-period cover.

normative_units.summary: Baby Care waiting period is 36 months for Plan 1 and decreases by one year when premium for a long-term policy is paid upfront.
normative_units.pressure_point: Baby Care is a distinct waiting-period type not present in the current base-mechanic vocabulary.

normative_units.summary: Portability carries accrued continuity benefits in waiting periods where coverage has been continuous without lapses.
Migration to another product/plan of the insurer carries accrued continuity benefits in waiting periods; withdrawal wording also refers to waiver of waiting period continuity benefits.
For any SI increase, waiting periods restart only for the enhanced portion. The enhanced limit is treated from its effective date as first-policy exposure for applicable waiting periods.
When a new insured beneficiary is added by endorsement or renewal, PED, exclusions, and waiting periods apply considering that policy year as the first policy year for that newly added beneficiary.
normative_units.pressure_point: Current waiting-period semantic vocabulary has renewal/reinstatement effects but no explicit newly-added-insured start/reset semantic.

normative_units.summary: Cataract surgery payment is subject to expiry of a waiting period specified in the Policy Schedule, while cost sharing varies by SI band.
normative_units.pressure_point: Waiting-period applicability is coupled to a separate cataract cost-sharing mechanic and SI-band applicability; the concepts must remain separate while retaining the dependency.

normative_units.summary: Day-care procedures remain subject to standard exclusions and waiting periods depending on the disease/condition under treatment.
